name: Pickup v. Brown
summary: The Ninth Circuit upheld California's ban on conversion therapy for minors, concluding that the law regulated professional conduct rather than speech and was subject only to rational basis review, which the state's interest in protecting minors satisfied.
significance: This Ninth Circuit precedent, which upheld California's similar conversion therapy ban as a regulation of professional conduct, is the primary lower-court ruling petitioners seek to have the Supreme Court overrule or distinguish.
